units.text: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is glad of it. From your mid-thirties a partner and a household widen your reach, with more coming in and more to look after. You take on the house as a project of your own, and the effort shows in every corner of it.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart made use of all of it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household was a working concern, a partner and you building something with real weight. You left that chapter with a home that stood firmly on its own.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart takes it in gladly. Since your mid-thirties the household has become a place of making things work, with a partner beside you and more to manage each year. Your home grows solid around the plans you see through, one fixed thing at a time.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties the household asks for steady effort, with bills to meet and plans to fund beside your own. You lean on someone close, and a job split in two stops eating your evenings.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart was working against it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household kept you running, with costs to cover and plans that pulled in different directions. With a partner's steadiness to lean on, you learned to measure a week by what you finished.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart pulls the other way. Since your mid-thirties, home has run on errands and accounts, with every week asking you to fetch and fix and pay. Each job you let wait gives you back an evening, and the house runs no worse for it.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart still wants it. From your late forties new chances keep coming within reach, and the people after you bring many of them. You pick the few that matter and make them pay.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is still eager for it. Since your late forties what you built has kept paying out, with fresh plans brought in by the people after you. You stay busy by choice, which is a different thing from staying busy.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, in a chart that works against it. From your late forties what you have built asks to be tended, along with requests and ventures the people after you set going. You take it task by task, and the rest keeps until tomorrow.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, though your chart leans away from it. Since your late forties there has been a steady pull to manage, to keep accounts and settle what the people after you ask for. You keep a walk before the day's requests begin, and that quiet hour holds the rest together.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart welcomed every bit of it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties there was always something within reach, a chance to earn or a door that opened when you pushed. You came out of those years sure of your own hands.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart has been waiting for it. Since your late teens, work and study have kept handing you things to take hold of, a first wage or a venture that pays its way. You reach a little further each year, and the misses teach as much as the catches.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart wanted less of it. Between your late teens and your mid-thirties work came with too many openings at once, each one asking for a piece of you. A friend with a level head steadied you, and from them you learned which chances to let pass.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, more than your chart can use. Since your late teens there has been more to chase than you could catch, offers and side ventures and people who want a share. You get through by finishing what you started before saying yes to the next thing.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart was hungry for it. The home you grew up in gave you things to do and things to reach for. You learned young that effort gets you what you want.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, into a chart that did better without it. Your first home was busy with getting and keeping, and the grown-ups around you counted every effort. You grew up restless, and an older relative's patience taught you to slow your reach.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart is ready for it. From your mid-thirties, home takes a firmer form, with a partner who keeps you to your word and duties that give the week its frame. You settle into that shape, and the relief surprises you.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart welcomed its firm hand. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household ran on agreements you and a partner kept, and every promise added to your name at home. You left it with a home that ran well and a name for doing what you said.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart has needed it for years. Since your mid-thirties home has given you a clear place, a partner who counts on you and routines that hold the week together. You know what each day asks of you, and the week stands straighter for it.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart pushes against it. From your mid-thirties the household brings obligation on obligation, a partner's expectations and a calendar that rarely clears. With time alone in a corner of your own, you keep your temper where others lose theirs.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart was already stretched by it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties home was full of duties, a partner's standards and a household that expected you on time. Someone who looked after you steadied you, and you learned to set down what was never yours to hold.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, an energy that works against your chart. Since your mid-thirties, home has come with rules and duties, a partner with firm views and a household that runs on schedule. You bend more than you would choose, and a walk with someone who hears you out straightens you by morning.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart still has use for it. From your late forties what you have built gives you a standing others look to, and the people after you ask how things should be done. You give them rules worth keeping, the first of which you keep yourself.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart has been glad to have it. Since your late forties you have held a settled place, the one whose word decides and whose standards the people after you take up. You pay for that authority in daily attention, and those who follow your lead can tell.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, though your chart would rather do without it. From your late forties duty follows you, with the people after you to answer for and a name you are expected to uphold. You find quiet hours for something of your own, and the weight is lighter on the days you do.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart wants less of it. Since your late forties you have been the one held responsible, for what you built and for how the people after you turn out. You turn down the smaller claims, and there is freedom in no longer having the final word.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart took to it at once. Between your late teens and your mid-thirties you found roles that fitted, with standards to meet and someone senior who noticed. You left those years with a name people trusted.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart is short of it. Since your late teens, work and study have given you titles to earn and people who hold you to account. You answer to them well, and each role you take on makes you more yourself.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart chafed against it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties work came with tight rules and managers who watched closely, and bending to fit cost you more than you showed. With loyal friends to keep you level, you came out able to stand firm under pressure.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart already strains under it. Since your late teens you have answered to managers, tutors and deadlines that rarely let up. With friends who knew you before any of it, you keep a part of yourself no role can claim.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart was the better for it. Your first home had an older relative whose word counted and rules everyone kept, and school gave each day a set shape. You grew up knowing where you stood, and that knowing held you upright.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Order, into a chart that already bent under it. Your first home asked a great deal of a child, strict hours and an older relative who expected more than you could give. You had one person there who softened things, and their kindness became a quiet strength of your own.
